name: Oumiya Sanpachi
source:
A crooked doushin of the North Magistrate's Office, known as the Money Frog of the North. Takes bribes, leers at Chizuru, and is convinced her brother is the Kurotengu.

[spoiler]A member of the Guhin crime syndicate and the one pulling the Kurotengu's strings.[/spoiler]
